mapper.select: SELECT A.USER_NO, A.USER_ID, A.PASSWORD, A.USER_NM, A.CTTPC_SE_CODE, A.CTTPC, A.EMAIL, A.AREA_CODE, C.CODE_NM AS AREA_CODE_NM, A.AREA_SE_CODE_S, D.SCLAS_NM AS AREA_SE_CODE_S_NM, A.AREA_SE_CODE_D , A.USER_STTUS_CODE, A.LOGIN_DT, A.USER_AGE, A.BIRTH_DATE, A.UNIQUE_IDENTIFIER, A.DEVICE_ID, A.DUPLICATE_IDENTIFIER, A.GENDER, A.MEMBER_CODE, A.CITIZENSHIP_TYPE, A.PASSWORD_HASH, A.REFERRER_ID, A.REGISTER_NO, A.REGIST_DT, A.UPDUSR_NO, A.UPDT_DT FROM op_user A LEFT JOIN op_code C ON C.GROUP_ID='R010070' AND C.CODE=A.AREA_CODE LEFT JOIN op_sclas_code D ON D.GROUP_ID='R010070' AND D.CODE=A.AREA_CODE AND D.SCLAS_CODE= A.AREA_SE_CODE_S WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO op_user ( USER_ID, PASSWORD, USER_NM, EMAIL, CTTPC_SE_CODE, CTTPC, AREA_CODE, AREA_SE_CODE_S, AREA_SE_CODE_D, GENDER, BIRTH_DATE, MEMBER_CODE, USER_STTUS_CODE, REFERRER_ID, REGIST_DT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{password}, #{userNm}, #{email}, '10', #{cttpc}, '10', #{areaSeCodeS}, #{areaSeCodeD}, #{gender}, #{birthDate}, #{memberCode}, #{userSttusCode}, #{referrerId}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT A.USER_NO AS userNo, A.USER_ID AS userId, A.USER_NM AS userNm FROM op_user A WHERE A.MEMBER_CODE = #{memberCode} AND A.USER_STTUS_CODE = '10' ORDER BY A.USER_NM
SELECT A.WHOLESALER_NO FROM op_user A WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT A.WHOLESALER_NO FROM op_user A WHERE A.USER_NO = #{userNo} LIMIT 1
SELECT USER_ID, USER_NM, EMAIL FROM op_user WHERE EMAIL = #{email} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_password_reset(USER_ID, SELECTOR, VERIFIER_HASH, EXPIRES_AT, USED_YN, REGIST_DT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{selector}, #{verifierHash}, #{expiresAt}, 'N', NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE SELECTOR = VALUES(SELECTOR), VERIFIER_HASH = VALUES(VERIFIER_HASH), EXPIRES_AT = VALUES(EXPIRES_AT), USED_YN = 'N'
INSERT INTO tb_social_account (USER_NO, PROVIDER, PROVIDER_USER_ID, LINKED_AT, LAST_LOGIN_AT) VALUES (#{userNo}, #{provider}, #{providerUserId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT A.USER_NO, A.USER_ID, A.PASSWORD, A.USER_NM, A.CTTPC_SE_CODE, A.CTTPC, A.EMAIL, A.AREA_CODE, C.CODE_NM AS AREA_CODE_NM, A.AREA_SE_CODE_S, D.SCLAS_NM AS AREA_SE_CODE_S_NM, A.AREA_SE_CODE_D, A.USER_STTUS_CODE, A.LOGIN_DT, A.USER_AGE, A.BIRTH_DATE, A.UNIQUE_IDENTIFIER, A.DEVICE_ID, A.DUPLICATE_IDENTIFIER, A.GENDER, A.MEMBER_CODE, A.CITIZENSHIP_TYPE, A.PASSWORD_HASH, A.REFERRER_ID, A.REGISTER_NO, A.REGIST_DT, A.UPDUSR_NO, A.UPDT_DT FROM op_user A JOIN tb_social_account S ON S.USER_NO = A.USER_NO LEFT JOIN op_code C ON C.GROUP_ID='R010070' AND C.CODE=A.AREA_CODE LEFT JOIN op_sclas_code D ON D.GROUP_ID='R010070' AND D.CODE=A.AREA_CODE AND D.SCLAS_CODE=A.AREA_SE_CODE_S WHERE S.PROVIDER = #{provider} AND S.PROVIDER_USER_ID = #{providerUserId} LIMIT 1
